description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Civil Aviation Act, establishing licensing requirements for aeronautical service providers. It creates a new regulatory framework for aviation security and air navigation services, specifying legal requirements, application procedures, certification standards, and enforcement mechanisms. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes subsidiary legislation under an existing act.
